case_number: 2023 INSC 704; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 5068 OF 2023; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S).5122 OF 2023; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 5070 OF 2023; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). 5086 OF 2023; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S).5121 OF 2023; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 5069 OF 2023; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S).5071-5084 OF 2023; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 5085 OF 2023; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). 5087 OF 2023; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). 5088-5120 OF 2023; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 5125 OF 2023; CIVIL APPEAL NOS.5123-5124/2023 OF 2023; WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) NO.137 OF 2022; WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) NO.881 OF 2022; WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) NO.355 OF 2022
summary: NCTE notification (28.06.2018) permitting B.Ed. holders for primary school teacher posts contested; Rajasthan HC quashed notification excluding B.Ed. eligibility; issue: whether NCTE validly equated B.Ed. qualification for primary school teaching; argument: NCTE followed Central Government policy directive under Section 29 NCTE Act vs. need for specialized teacher training; Court upheld NCTE notification, emphasizing quality education mandate under Article 21A; RTET Level-1 advertisements excluding B.Ed. candidates invalidated; policy decision of expert body sustained.
final_judgment: Rajasthan High Court judgment quashing NCTE notification set aside; B.Ed. qualification recognized for primary school teachers; appeals allowed; writ petitions decided accordingly.
